description: 道歉不是一句 Sorry。承认影响、不找借口、提出弥补，必要时也把边界说清楚。

targetChunks.note: owe someone an apology = 欠一个道歉，比 I'm sorry 更有分量。
只承认自己的行为，不评价对方，修复关系的第一步。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I handled that badly, and I've been thinking about it.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 那件事我处理得很糟，我一直在想。

targetChunks.en: I'm not going to make excuses.
targetChunks.note: 直接堵住「但是」，让对方更容易听下去。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I'm not going to make excuses — I was out of line.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我不找借口，是我越界了。

targetChunks.en: I didn't mean to come across that way.
targetChunks.zh: 我不是想给人那种感觉。
targetChunks.note: come across = 给人印象；解释动机但不推卸影响。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I didn't mean to come across that way.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我不是想给人那种感觉。

targetChunks.en: I can see how that landed.
targetChunks.zh: 我能理解那听起来是什么效果。
targetChunks.note: land = 话语造成的效果；承认影响，比解释更有用。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I can see how that landed, and I get why you were upset.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我能理解那听起来是什么效果，也明白你为什么生气。

targetChunks.en: That's not quite what I meant.
targetChunks.note: 澄清意图，但不要用来逃避责任；后面要接弥补。
targetChunks.exampleEn: That's not quite what I meant, but I see how it sounded.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我不是这个意思，但我明白听起来像。

targetChunks.en: What can I do to make it right?
targetChunks.note: 把修复交给对方提，比自作主张更真诚。
targetChunks.exampleEn: What can I do to make it right?

targetChunks.note: 承诺要具体，最好说清「怎么做」。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I'll do better next time — I'll check with you before I joke about that.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 下次我会做得更好，开这种玩笑前先问你。

targetChunks.en: Can we talk about what happened?
targetChunks.zh: 我们能聊聊发生了什么吗？
targetChunks.note: 不回避冲突，邀请对话；比 We need to talk 温和。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Can we talk about what happened?
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我们能聊聊发生了什么吗？

targetChunks.en: I need to set a boundary here.
targetChunks.note: 道歉不等于无限退让；边界可以用平静语气说。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I need to set a boundary here — I'd rather we talk directly next time.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 这里我得设个边界，下次我们最好直接沟通。

targetChunks.en: Thanks for giving me another chance.
targetChunks.zh: 谢谢你再给我一次机会。
targetChunks.note: 收尾时承认对方的宽容，不要理所当然。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Thanks for giving me another chance.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 谢谢你再给我一次机会。

roleplay.promptZh: 你在聚会上开了个让朋友难堪的玩笑。对方明显疏远了你。你要主动道歉：承认影响、不找借口、提出弥补，并说清以后的边界。
roleplay.promptEn: You made a joke at a party that embarrassed your friend. They've been distant. Apologize: acknowledge the impact, avoid excuses, make amends, and set a boundary.
goals: 承认行为与影响，不急着解释动机
道歉的同时说清未来边界

script.speaker: other
script.en: You've been a bit off with me lately.
script.zh: 你最近对我有点不对劲。

script.speaker: you
script.en: I owe you an apology. I handled that badly.
script.zh: 我该向你道歉。那件事我处理得很糟。

script.speaker: other
script.en: You made that joke in front of everyone.
script.zh: 你当着所有人的面开了那个玩笑。

script.speaker: you
script.en: I know. I didn't mean to come across that way, and I'm not going to make excuses.
script.zh: 我知道。我不是想给人那种感觉，也不找借口。

script.speaker: you
script.en: I can see how that landed. That's not quite what I meant, but I get why it sounded that way.
script.zh: 我能理解那听起来是什么效果。我不是这个意思，但我明白为什么会那样。

script.speaker: other
script.en: Okay. I appreciate you saying that.

script.speaker: you
script.en: What can I do to make it right? And I need to set a boundary here — I'd rather we talk directly next time.
script.zh: 我能怎么弥补？另外这里我得设个边界，下次我们最好直接沟通。
